input.subject: Washing machine clicking – Flat 29, 19 Copperfield Walk (Ref NBL-039-2915 / R/PM039-1)
input.body:
Hi Nora,

Thank you for getting back to us about the clicking noise from the washing machine at Flat 29, 19 Copperfield Walk, Northbridge, ZZ9 1ZZ (job ref NBL-039-2915).

Yes, a short video would be really helpful, please. When you record it, could you also let us know whether you have checked the drum and the door seal (the rubber gasket) with the machine empty and found nothing caught in there, such as a coin, hair grip or underwired bra? Please switch the machine off at the plug before you check.

Once we have that, we'll pass the details to the landlord so we can arrange for someone to take a look. In the meantime it's fine to keep using the machine as long as the noise doesn't get worse. If it starts leaking, smells of burning or makes a loud banging noise, please stop using it, switch it off at the plug and let us know straight away.

Many thanks

data.reasoning: The tenant still hasn't confirmed the drum check, so I should follow up asking them to confirm it and send the video. Since I don't have landlord contact details yet, I'll hold off on requesting approval and just focus on emailing the tenant first.

The ticket is on hold for 3 days. Once we have their answer, the next step is asking the landlord to approve an appliance engineer.
